chain.title: The Stone That Starts Everything
chain.desc: Has no recipe anywhere in the jar; it is injected chest loot, and the mod's root advancement fires the moment one enters your inventory.

chain.title: Longer Than a Sword Should Be
chain.desc: One of fifteen weapon families, each with its own rolled implicit; the Longsword line can deflect incoming damage.

chain.title: Diamond, Drawn Out
chain.desc: The diamond tier of the same family and the required base for the netherite smithing upgrade.

chain.title: Netherite Answers the Template
chain.desc: A Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template plus a Netherite Ingot on the diamond weapon, exactly as vanilla.

chain.title: Runes Etched Into Netherite
chain.desc: Smithing with a Runic Tablet as template and a plain Diamond as addition; the weapon keeps its type and implicit and gains a Runic Power.

chain.title: The Only Bench That Matters
chain.desc: Obsidian, Amethyst Shards, a Smithing Table and a Runic Tablet; the sole place tablets and gems can be added to or pulled from a Unique.

chain.title: What a Unique Leaves Behind
chain.desc: Smelting any weapon in the simplyswords:uniques tag returns this remnant along with 35 experience.

chain.title: Obsidian That Wept
chain.desc: Smithed from a Runic Tablet template, an Empowered Remnant base and Crying Obsidian; it rolls one power from the Runic pool.

chain.title: A Second Socket, A Second Power
chain.desc: The same smithing shape with a Netherite Ingot instead, rolling from the Nether power pool.

chain.title: Remnant Behind Glass
chain.desc: Iron, Glass and an Empowered Remnant; held in hand it hints at nearby blocks that will turn it into a specific Unique.

chain.title: Struck on an Iron Block
chain.desc: The deterministic Contained Remnant target for an Iron Block, per the mod's own guidebook.

chain.title: Opened at the End Portal
chain.desc: Using a Contained Remnant on an End Portal Frame; its ability tears a breach that summons corrupted allies for 45 seconds.

chain.title: Woken Over Soul Fire
chain.desc: The Contained Remnant target for Soul Fire, and the first of three persistent Lichblade forms.

chain.title: Half Awake
chain.desc: The Lichblade's form at Runic Forge awakening levels 4 through 7, carrying Soul Anguish II.

chain.title: Soul Anguish, Fully Voiced
chain.desc: Awakening level 8 in the Runic Forge; the returning-soul absorption effect unlocks only at this stage.

chain.title: A Faint Power Within
chain.desc: A lootable Unique whose form branches instead of simply strengthening; feed it tablets to find out which way.

chain.title: Chosen by Daylight
chain.desc: The Dormant Relic taken to awakening level 4 in the Runic Forge during Overworld daytime.

chain.title: Standard of the Sun
chain.desc: Righteous Relic carried to level 8; it plants a Righteous Battle Standard that burns foes and buffs nearby players.

chain.title: Chosen by Night
chain.desc: The same level 4 transformation performed after dark, taking the abyssal branch instead.

chain.title: Standard of the Abyss
chain.desc: Tainted Relic at level 8; its standard drags enemies inward and grants haste to allies.

chain.title: Something Stirs in the Dark
chain.desc: An Unformed Relic with no implicit at all until the Deep Dark changes it; keep it in your pack while you explore.

chain.title: Answered by a Sonic Boom
chain.desc: Taking a Warden's sonic boom while carrying the Decaying Relic converts it, preserving its components and awakening level.

chain.title: Five Stacks of Dread
chain.desc: A lootable Unique whose hits build Dread on a target, summoning a bat per stack and executing anything left under a quarter health.

chain.title: Reforged Where the Sculk Grows
chain.desc: The Watcher at awakening level 4 or higher, reforged at a Runic Forge standing in the Deep Dark; reforging it below level 4 reverts it.

notes: Item set = 472 stems of assets/simplyswords/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json (141 ids); the excluded stems are the mythicmetals and gobber compat model folders and tooltip-only lang keys. Progression read from data/simplyswords/recipes/** (iron/gold/diamond crafting_shaped, netherite_* smithing_transform off the diamond weapon, runic_* smithing_transform off the netherite weapon using simplyswords:runic_tablet as template and minecraft:diamond as addition, runic2_* re-roll recipes, runefused_gem and netherfused_gem from Empowered Remnant, unique_melting smelting the whole simplyswords:uniques tag into an Empowered Remnant, and runic_forge from obsidian, amethyst, a smithing table and a tablet), from data/simplyswords/advancements/** (root fires on holding a runic_tablet, runic_weapon is its child, and every Unique hangs off runic_weapon except awakened_lichblade<-slumbering_lichblade, sunfire and harbinger<-dormant_relic, magiblade/magiscythe/magispear<-decaying_relic, the_devourer<-the_watcher, soulstalker<-soulrender, gloampiercer<-wickpiercer, wraithmaw<-wraithfang, dreadwhisper<-whisperwind, ionbound_stormscale<-stormscale), and from the in-jar guidebook assets/oracle_index/books/simplyswords/ (awakening.mdx, runic_forge.mdx, gem_socketing.mdx, unique-weapons/*.mdx). The guidebook supplies the transformation conditions quoted above: Decaying Relic reacts to a Warden sonic boom, a Sculk Sensor or Darkness; Dormant Relic splits at level 4 on Overworld day/night and finishes at level 8; The Watcher becomes The Devourer when reforged in the Deep Dark at level 4+; and Contained Remnant targets include Iron Block -> Mjolnir, Copper Bulb -> Storm's Edge, End Portal Frame -> Caelestis, Soul Fire -> Slumbering Lichblade. Collection 1 is the thirteen runic weapon types other than the hub; collection 2 is drawn from data/simplyswords/tags/items/lootable_uniques.json; collection 3 is every transformation-gated Unique. Nothing dropped. moddb agreement: 24 of moddb's 26 ids are inside the verified set and the late half matches well (runic_tablet, watching_warglaive, arcanethyst, empowered_remnant, dormant_relic, hearthflame, runefused_gem, netherfused_gem, molten_edge, soulrender, soulkeeper, thunderbrand, mjolnir, soulstealer, twisted_blade, watcher_claymore all rise in roughly the order used here). Conflict: moddb ranks decaying_relic 0.000, magiscythe 0.020, magispear 0.041, magiblade 0.061, enigma 0.102 and contained_remnant 0.122 as the earliest entries in the mod, but the jar makes all six strictly downstream - the Decaying Relic is a lootable Unique that only becomes a Magi weapon through Deep Dark events, and the Contained Remnant needs an Empowered Remnant, which needs a Unique to smelt. Those moddb positions come from packs listing the relic family as one early quest page, not from a gate, so this chain follows the recipe and advancement graph instead.
